Which category do I spend the most on? Call it top_category(). If two tie, pick the alphabetically first; with no expenses, null.

top_category
	| spent best bestCents |
	spent := self by_category.
	spent isEmpty ifTrue: [ ^ nil ].
	best := nil.
	bestCents := nil.
	spent keys asSortedCollection do: [ :category |
		| cents |
		cents := ((spent at: category) * 100) rounded.
		(bestCents isNil or: [ cents > bestCents ])
			ifTrue: [ best := category. bestCents := cents ] ].
	^ best
